title: The First Dream
journal: Vosh-Leera has a second task for me. I'm to ask her for it in her house in Jal-Veesa.
objectives: Ask Vosh-Leera for her second task. (marker: Vosh-Leera)

plan.going: I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka through Vosh-Leera; the trees are sick and nobody knows why.
plan.next: Ask Vosh-Leera, in her house, for the second task.

answers: I was freed from the Owing by Vosh-Leera, root-herald of Jal-Veesa. She secretly serves the Toh-Reel-Ka, Secret Warriors of the Xeech-Leel, who try to prevent another Umbriel-type disaster. Jal-Veesa Hist is dying and trees along the river are sick; nobody knows why.
Go to Vosh-Leera at her house in Jal-Veesa and ask for her second task.
I can accept her task, ask questions first, or refuse; I can also ask Weeltul about sap, scar and Umbriel. I mean to resolve things in a comforting way.
I do not know why the trees are sick, what the second task is, or fully what the Toh-Reel-Ka want. I can find out by asking Vosh-Leera and Weeltul.

title: The First Dream
journal: Vosh-Leera gave me a cup of Jal-Veesa's sap, drawn before its scar closed. Tree-minders drink sap to ask the trees a question, and she wants me to ask where the sickness is. I'm to drink it here, in front of her.
objectives: Drink the cup of sap in front of Vosh-Leera. (marker: Vosh-Leera)

plan.going: Sap drunk brings visions the trees send; Vosh-Leera wants me to ask the trees where the sickness is.
plan.next: Drink the cup in front of her, by telling her I will.

answers: Vosh-Leera gave me a cup of Hist sap from before the scar closed. Drinking it lets me ask the trees, which are joined at the root, where the sickness is. She works for the Toh-Reel-Ka and wants me to report what I see.
Drink the sap here in front of Vosh-Leera and ask where the sickness is, then tell her everything I see.
I can drink it now, first ask Weeltul about sap, or refuse. I do not know the risks of drinking it.
I do not know what drinking sap will do to me or whether it is safe. I could ask Weeltul about the sap before drinking.

title: The First Dream
journal: I drank the sap and the world went black. I saw a young Hist among stilt huts beside a woven weir, and a reed hide beside a lone dead tree. I'm to tell Vosh-Leera what I saw.
objectives: Tell Vosh-Leera what you saw. (marker: Vosh-Leera)

plan.going: The sap showed me a young Hist by a woven weir among stilt huts, and a reed hide by a lone dead tree.
plan.next: Tell Vosh-Leera what I saw, one thing at a time.

answers: I drank the sap and had a vision: a young Hist among stilt huts beside a woven weir, and a reed hide beside a lone dead tree. This may show where the sickness is.
Tell Vosh-Leera what I saw, here at Jal-Veesa.
I can report it fully, or hold something back; I mean to be honest and comforting.
I do not know where the weir, huts or dead tree are, or what they mean. Vosh-Leera or Weeltul may know.

title: The First Dream
journal: Vosh-Leera knew the place from what I told her. It is Teel-Fen Weir, a weir-wardens' camp south of Jal-Veesa, where a young Hist grew from the roots of Jal-Veesa's own. Heem-Jasa minds its tree there. I'm to go to Teel-Fen Weir and speak to Heem-Jasa.
objectives: Speak to Heem-Jasa at Teel-Fen Weir. (marker: Heem-Jasa)

plan.going: The vision showed Teel-Fen Weir, whose young Hist grew from Jal-Veesa's roots.
plan.next: Go south to Teel-Fen Weir and speak to Heem-Jasa, its tree-minder.

answers: My vision showed Teel-Fen Weir, a Sedge-Wardens camp south of Jal-Veesa where a young Hist grew from Jal-Veesa tree roots. Someone at a reed hide beside a dead tree is keeping jars of sap, which may be linked to the sickness. I work for Vosh-Leera and the Toh-Reel-Ka.
Go to Teel-Fen Weir and speak to Heem-Jasa, its tree-minder, on the platform round the tree.
I can talk to Heem-Jasa first as Vosh-Leera advised, or go to the hide, which I was warned to be careful about.
I do not know who keeps the jars at the hide or why. Heem-Jasa may tell me.

title: The First Dream
journal: Heem-Jasa showed me her young tree's scar. It closed three nights ago over a grey paste that none of her people put there. Someone drained the tree and sealed it. Strangers keep jars at the reed hide by the lone dead tree west of the weir, the hide from my vision. I'm to take what they have. I can fight them, shoot them from the reeds, or creep in to the jars unseen.
objectives: Take the note from the reed hide west of Teel-Fen Weir. (marker: Note to the Sap-Takers)

plan.going: The young tree was drained and sealed with a grey paste by people, not by sickness. The strangers at the hide keep jars of sap.
plan.next: Go to the reed hide west of the weir and take the note lying with the jars; take a jar too.
plan.ways: Fight the three, shoot them from the reeds, or sneak to the west side of the hide and take the note unseen.

answers: Someone is draining Hist trees of sap and sealing the scars with grey paste. Heem-Jasa found her young tree drained and sealed three nights ago. Strangers (Sap-Takers) keep jars at the reed hide west of the weir.
Take the note from the reed hide west of Teel-Fen Weir.
Fight the three Sap-Takers, shoot them from the reeds east of the hide, or sneak round the open west side to the jars and note. I prefer the least bloody way, sneaking.
I do not know who the Sap-Takers work for, what the grey paste is, or what the note says. The note may tell me.

title: The First Dream
journal: I took the note from the reed hide. The crew's master orders them to bring their jars to Karsh-Naal Camp, and to seal every scar behind them. I'm to go back to Heem-Jasa on the platform. She will ask whether her tree will live; she teaches and trades only with those who are straight with her.
objectives: Return to Heem-Jasa at Teel-Fen Weir. (marker: Heem-Jasa)

plan.going: The sap-takers drain trees and seal them on someone's orders, and carry the jars to Karsh-Naal Camp.
plan.next: Go back to Heem-Jasa, who will ask whether her tree will live.
plan.ways: Tell her the truth (it may die: she then trains me in Alchemy and sells to me) or a comfort (it will live: she gives me three potions of Cure Poison now, but will not train or trade with me).

answers: I got the note unseen. The Sap-Takers master orders them to bring jars to Karsh-Naal Camp and seal every scar behind them. So an organized group is draining Hist trees.
Return to Heem-Jasa at Teel-Fen Weir; she will ask whether her tree will live.
Tell her honestly, or comfort her; I mean to comfort her without lying about what I know. I can later go to Karsh-Naal Camp.
I do not know where Karsh-Naal Camp is, who the master is, or whether the tree will live.

title: The First Dream
journal: I told Heem-Jasa her tree will live. She gave me three potions of Cure Poison. She trades and teaches only with kin and with those who are straight with her. The note names Karsh-Naal Camp.

plan.going: I told Heem-Jasa her tree will live. She gave me three potions of Cure Poison. She trades and teaches only with kin and with those who are straight with her. The note names Karsh-Naal Camp.

answers: Someone is draining Hist trees and sealing scars with grey paste; the Sap-Takers work for a master who sends jars to Karsh-Naal Camp. I comforted Heem-Jasa that her tree will live, though I do not truly know that.
The quest is complete; nothing further is set. I could report to Vosh-Leera or look into Karsh-Naal Camp.
